title: Cashiering Clearing Standard — Payments Counted toward Reconnecting Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Standard.** In working out what a member still has to pay to have a disconnected Electric Service by Rate Schedule account reconnected, the payments of the month — payments on the service account dated less than one whole month before the current date — are counted as follows. The returned payments of the month are taken off in every case.

| Account record | Payments counted |
|---|---|
| The account is on cash-only status through the current date (its cash-only end date is on or after the current date) | Only the payments of the month through the channels accepted on cash-only status — office cash, money order, online card, phone IVR card and payment kiosk; the other payments of the month are left out |
| Not on cash-only status, and the latest payment through online e-check, mailed check, office check or automatic bank draft, taken channel by channel, is dated no more than 5 calendar days before the current date | Every payment of the month except each such uncleared payment, which is left out until it clears |
| Any other case | Every payment of the month |

"Taken channel by channel" means that for each of those four channels only that channel's latest payment is looked at; where it is dated within the 5 calendar days it is left out, and an earlier payment through the same channel is counted.

### Hypothetical case (current date June 20)

Payments of the month: phone IVR card $100.00 on June 2; office check $60.00 on June 10; online e-check $50.00 on June 16; online e-check $40.00 on June 18. No returned payment.

| Cash-only status | Left out | Payments counted |
|---|---|---|
| None | The $40.00 e-check of June 18 (the latest e-check, 2 days old); the office check of June 10 is 10 days old and counts | $210.00 |
| Through June 30 | Every payment except the phone IVR card payment | $100.00 |

### Points of reading

- A payment dated exactly 5 calendar days before the current date is still uncleared; one dated 6 days before is counted.
- Energy assistance agency payments are not among the channels accepted on cash-only status.
